# FDN Hoarding Dragon: "Flying. When this creature enters, you may search your library for an
# artifact card, exile it, then shuffle. When this creature dies, you may put the exiled card into
# its owner's hand."
# Enters: M21 Solemn Simulacrum's verified "you may search your library for a basic land card, put
# that card onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle." (B2b-etb-basic-land: OptionalEffect(Seq(
# SEARCH, SHUFFLE)), no `controller` role on SEARCH) with an artifact card and the destination
# exile, Zone(EXILE, OWNER) as every compiled exile writes it (M21 Necromentia's SEARCH exiles).
# Dies: M21 Solemn Simulacrum's "When this creature dies, you may ..." (OptionalEffect) with the
# move of "the exiled card", the card the linked enters ability exiled (CR 607.2a): M20 Bag of
# Holding's verified IS_EXILED_WITH_SOURCE selector over every exile zone (an ALL: the card is
# named, not chosen), to its owner's hand.
etb = TriggeredAbility(
    event=ZoneChangeEvent(
        from_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.ANY, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),
        to_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
        subject=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
    ),
    condition=None,
    effect=OptionalEffect(
        inner=Seq(
            steps=(
                A(Verb.SEARCH, {
                    'cards': Selector(
                        count=QConst(value=1),
                        mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE,
                        filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Artifact'),
                        zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.LIBRARY, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),),
                    ),
                    'destination': Zone(kind=ZoneKind.EXILE, controller=ControllerRef.OWNER),
                }),
                A(Verb.SHUFFLE, {'zone': Zone(kind=ZoneKind.LIBRARY, controller=ControllerRef.YOU)}),
            ),
        ),
    ),
)
dies = TriggeredAbility(
    event=CreatureDiesEvent(filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE)),
    condition=None,
    effect=OptionalEffect(
        inner=A(Verb.MOVE_ZONE, {
            'cards': Selector(
                count=QUnbounded(),
                mode=SelectorMode.ALL,
                filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_EXILED_WITH_SOURCE),
                zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.EXILE, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
            ),
            'destination': Zone(kind=ZoneKind.HAND, controller=ControllerRef.OWNER),
        }),
    ),
)
abilities = [etb, dies, *compiled]

clauses.clause: When this creature enters, you may search your library for an artifact card, exile it, then shuffle.
clauses.ir: abilities[0] (OptionalEffect: SEARCH an artifact card to exile, SHUFFLE)

clauses.clause: When this creature dies, you may put the exiled card into its owner's hand.
clauses.ir: abilities[1] (OptionalEffect: MOVE_ZONE the card exiled with this creature to its owner's hand)
